messages.content: You are a helpful Swift assistant. Answer accurately and state meaningful uncertainty.

Deployment target: macOS 26.0. Framework: AppKit.

Our AppKit invoice list reuses an NSStackView row containing a title, Open button and Save button. Implement a programmatic row that can be configured repeatedly with a new title, complete localized control names and callbacks. Keep both buttons independently usable, and offer Save as an optional accessibility action on Open. Disabled Save must not dispatch. What would you implement, and what can unit tests establish?
